reaction: It was satisfying to see the filtering and drainage routes come together.

mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances made the kidney’s two-stage job understandable, especially because glucose and water pass through the filter too.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly predictable because the slots and pictures showed where they went.

surprise.text: The filter let useful substances through along with wastes, rather than selecting only waste.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and goals gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: connecting the kidney’s filtering, recovery and drainage was understandable, and I’d be curious to see another body process built this way.
